moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio optimistic-update, written here): Row 240x40 r10 with a checkbox, label and status. Tap at 0.35 s: the checkbox fills accent at once with a bump 1 → 1.12 → 1 (0.2 s), the row tints accent 14 %; status PENDING with a small spinner arc (r5, 9 rad/s) until 1.95 s; then '✓ CONFIRMED' (green) fades in 0.25 s and the tint fades out 0.5 s; reset 2.85-3.1 s. The UI / server timeline lanes below are the lesson part (optional). Params: tap (0.35 s) · confirm (1.95 s) · bump (1.12) · labels (PENDING → ✓ CONFIRMED). The row changes at once on the tap (accent tint 14 %, checkbox bump), shows a pending spinner, then turns confirmed when the server lane catches up.
